name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 6,300 experience instead of 2,650, 2.38 times as much. Read from what the game server sent in the beta. Its experience counts the level 30 build, which halved what dungeon quests give beyond a normal quest.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
This Twilight's Hammer follower cannot be allowed to complete his plan. The Twilight's Hammer do not understand the spirits of nature. They believe in the Old Gods--creatures of chaos and destruction that were long ago defeated. This Lorgus cannot be allowed to succeed. You must stop him, adventurer. I cannot do it myself--I am too weak.

Go into Blackfathom Deeps, find him, and kill him. Return to me here at Zoram'gar when it's done.
narrative.objectives: Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
narrative.offerRewardText: Very good!! Thank you, adventurer. We may not have stopped the Twilight's Hammer completely, but at least you have staved off another of their plans to return the Old Gods to power.Who knows what other plans they have manifesting, but we can rest easy for now.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you found him yet, adventurer? Lorgus must be stopped!

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 22 to 26, 7,600 XP in all.
